title: Security Deposit Account Heavy-Use Cleaning Charge for Households Larger Than the Home
content:
**Q. When does a household carry a heavy-use cleaning charge on its Security Deposit Account?**
A. A household larger than its home carries a heavy-use cleaning charge. The size of the household is the number of approved occupants on the Apartment Home Lease. The size of the home is the number of bedrooms of the lease's floor plan. The charge is:

- **40.00 USD** when the approved occupants exceed the bedrooms by two or more;
- **20.00 USD** when they exceed them by exactly one;
- **nothing** when they do not exceed them.

**Q. How does the charge enter the corrected cleaning charge?**
A. It is added to the corrected cleaning charge. The corrected cleaning charge is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Q. Which records decide it?**
A. The approved occupants recorded on the Apartment Home Lease, and the bedroom count of the lease's floor plan.

### Ladder by excess of occupants over bedrooms

| Approved occupants minus bedrooms | Heavy-use cleaning charge |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 40.00 USD |
| exactly 1 | 20.00 USD |
| 0 or fewer | none |

### Hypothetical cases

- 5 approved occupants in a floor plan with 3 bedrooms: the excess is 2, so the charge is 40.00 USD.
- 4 approved occupants with 3 bedrooms: the excess is 1, so the charge is 20.00 USD.
- 3 approved occupants with 3 bedrooms: no excess, so there is no charge.
